title: Bill 145 property tax exemption for child care
summary: At the Commission on Children and Youth, a speaker raised Bill 145, a property tax exemption for child care providers that committees raised from $100,000 to $200,000. The chair asked commissioners to read the bill, and it was discussed at the next meeting.
